facts.value: Please take the TOEFL at a test center, as many of our partner universities do not accept the TOEFL Home Edition.

facts.value: No proof through the Abitur certificate is accepted unless it is explicitly stated in the certificate that you have unrestricted access to foreign universities with language acquisition.

facts.value: If B2 is specified, you can apply with proof from the department (B2.1 or B2.2) or an equivalent to the DAAD Test.

facts.value: If you do not speak the local language of the host country, it is recommended to acquire basic knowledge of the corresponding language where possible. However, this is not a prerequisite for application.

facts.value: If multiple language requirements are listed (e.g., B2/TOEFL/IELTS), these should be understood as alternatives, meaning you only need to submit proof of one.
